staticMarkers.title: Reshala Spawn
staticMarkers.desc:
• Reshala is followed by 4 aggressive guards that push the player.
• The followers all have the last name Zavodskoy.
• Reshala can spawn with Physical Bitcoin in his pockets.

staticMarkers.title: Cultist Spawn
staticMarkers.desc:
• Cultists appear between 22:00 and 6:30.
• Cultist's footsteps have reduced volume.
• Cultists are cold blooded,can hardly be spotted with thermals.
• Killing Cultists as a Scav does not carry any penalties towards Scav karma.

staticMarkers.title: Goons Spawn
staticMarkers.desc:
• Killing Goons as a Scav doesn’t result in any Scav karma penalties.
• Birdeyes's footsteps have reduced volume.
• When any one of the Goons spots a player, Knight and Big Pipe will both push the player, while Birdeye stands and lets them engage the player first.
• Birdeye will only push the player after both Knight and Big Pipe are dead.
